records.claim: Miscarriage is common and can occur in any pregnancy for many different reasons. A few studies have reported slightly more miscarriages among women taking carbamazepine during pregnancy, while other studies have not reported this finding. Because miscarriage can happen for many reasons, it is hard to know whether the medication, the condition being treated, or other factors such as age or health are the cause.
